The Mind Behind the Music

Emmit Christopher, aka Maze 28, a multi-talented artist, rapper, singer, songwriter, producer, and poet, born in Kampala, Uganda on August 10th, 2002.

Standing at 5ft11 with dark brown eyes and black hair, I'm a creative force to be reckoned with. My music is a reflection of my experiences, thoughts, and emotions, all woven together with a unique blend of lyrics and melodies.

Known for storytelling prowess, thought-provoking lyrics, satire and social commentary, on a mission to share my art with the world, inspiring and connecting with like-minded individuals along the way.

Take a listen, to glimpse Into the Mind of an Overthinker

Welcome Into the Mind of an Overthinker!

The Journey Begins

Get ready to experience the unfiltered through the eyes of Maze 28. With his Debut album taking listeners on a journey of self-discovery, perseverance, and empowerment.

Raw & Honest

Through his raw, honest lyrics, he shares his story of overcoming adversity, navigating relationships, and staying true to himself.

Unique Sound

With a unique blend of Hip-hop, Soul and Afro-centric elements, his music is a reflection of his eclectic personality and artistic vision.

Sonic Journey

Join him on his sonic journey and re-discover the power of music to inspire, heal, and uplift the soul.
